items.headline: Van Gogh ki painting $190.4 million me biki
items.detail: Sotheby's New York me Van Gogh ki 1890 ki 'Chataigniers en fleurs' $190.4 million me biki — kalakar ka ab tak ka sabse bada nilami record; Nazi kaal ke malikana vivad par samjhauta hua tha.
items.exam_angle: Nilami record aur sanskritik sampatti ka vivad — UPSC ke liye upyogi.
items.image_credit: Vincent van Gogh (Public domain, Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Trump Iran par naye hamle par vichar
items.detail: New York Times ki report ke mutabik Rashtrapati Trump Iran par naye bade hamlo par vichar kar rahe hain; Netanyahu chaar se saat din ke sanyukt hawai abhiyan ke liye dabav bana rahe hain, lekin abhi koi faisla nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur Hormuz: UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Aaj ICJ Rohingya par faisla sunayega
items.detail: Antarrashtriya Nyayalaya aaj The Hague me Gambia ke 2019 ke mukadme par faisla sunayega — kya Myanmar ne 2017 me Rohingya ke khilaf narsanhar kiya; faisla IST dopahar 2:30 se padha jayega.
items.exam_angle: ICJ aur 1948 Narsanhar Samjhauta — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Peltola ne Alaska Senate seat jeeti
items.detail: Democrat Mary Peltola ne Alaska Senate chunav me Republican Dan Sullivan ko haraya; unki jeet se Senate me Democrats ki sankhya 56 ho gayi, aur ve Senate pahunchne wali pehli Alaska Native bani.
items.exam_angle: America ke midterm natije aur ranked-choice voting — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Leah Herman / U.S. House of Representatives (Public domain, Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Anthropic ka $83 IPO, sabse bada tech listing
items.detail: AI company Anthropic ne apna IPO $83 prati share par tay kiya; 980 million share se $81.3 arab juta — ab tak ka sabse bada tech IPO, aaj Nasdaq par ANT ticker se trading shuru hogi.
items.exam_angle: IPO aur AI company ka pehla bada public listing — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Bayesian report: hawa ka khatra anjana tha
items.detail: Britain ki MAIB ne kaha superyacht Bayesian 2024 me Sicily ke paas tez hawa se 15 second me palat gayi thi, saat log mare gaye the; uski hawa se kamzori ka aaklan kabhi hua hi nahi tha, isliye chalak-dal ko khatre ka pata nahi tha.
items.exam_angle: Samudri suraksha jaanch aur MAIB ki bhoomika — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Machado ne Trump tel saude par sawal uthaye
items.detail: Venezuela ki vipaksh neta Maria Corina Machado ne America ke 100 arab dollar wale tel saude me pardarshita ki kami par sawal uthaye; kaha har saude ki dobara jaanch hogi, lekin America se lambi saajhedari zaroori hai.
items.exam_angle: Venezuela tel sauda aur America ki videsh neeti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz me teen tanker mine se aag
items.detail: Iran ke anusar Hormuz ke poorv me teen tel tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag me ghire; Iran ka daava hai jahaz pratibandhit kshetra me the, swatantra pushti abhi nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz: vishwa tel vyapar ka mahatvapurna jaladmarumadhya.

items.headline: Crimean Bridge par hafte me teesra hamla
items.detail: Crimea ke governor ke anusar is hafte teesri baar Crimean Bridge par hamle ke baad yatayat roka gaya; nuksan ka aaklan chal raha hai.
items.exam_angle: Kerch Bridge: Russia-Crimea ko jodne wala 19 km lamba pul.

items.headline: NSA outage se Middle East khufiya kaam thappa
items.detail: America ki National Security Agency ke network me do din se chal rahi gadbad se Georgia kendra me Middle East par khufiya kaam ruk gaya; NSANet band hua, lekin sabse samvedansheel pranaliyan chal rahi hain aur cyber hamle ki baat nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: America ki khufiya sanrachna aur cyber suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Iran ne Kuwait-Bahrain me US thikano par hamla
items.detail: Iran ke drone ne Kuwait ke Ali Al-Salem air base aur Bahrain me US sainya thikano ko nishana banaya; dono deshon ne hamle roke, koi nuksan ya hatahat ki khabar nahi.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me US sainya adde aur America-Iran tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America-Venezuela sainya saajhedari ka samjhota
items.detail: America ke raksha mantri Pete Hegseth ne Caracas ki achanak yatra me Venezuela ke saath sainya sahyog ka samjhota kiya; sanyukt prashikshan aur khufiya jaankari sajha karenge, antaram rashtrapati Delcy Rodriguez se bhi mile.
items.exam_angle: Venezuela me January me Maduro ko hatane ke baad America ka badhta prabhav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Takaichi ne Putin se pehli mulaqat ki
items.detail: Japan ki PM Sanae Takaichi ne Shenzhen me APEC ke kinare Russia ke rashtrapati Vladimir Putin se lagbhag 30 minute baat ki; 2019 ke baad dono deshon ke netaon ki pehli aamne-saamne mulaqat hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan-Russia sambandh aur APEC shikhar sammelan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Odesa par hamle me chaar mare, 13 ghayal
items.detail: Russia ne Budhvar ko Ukraine ke Odesa shahar ke aitihasik kendra par teen hamle kiye; chaar log mare gaye aur 13 ghayal hue, aur UNESCO-sanrakshit ilake me saat imaraton ki khidkiyan toot gayin.
items.exam_angle: Odesa: Krishna Sagar ka mahatvapurna bandargah aur UNESCO sthal.

items.headline: Waymo ki driverless gaadiyan freeway se hati
items.detail: California ke DMV ne suraksha chinta par Waymo ki driverless gaadiyon par freeway pratibandh lagaya; company ne America bhar me freeway seva asthayi roop se roki, shahar ki sadkon par seva jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Driverless gaadiyon ka niyaman aur AI suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Kumamoto me 5.7 ka bhukamp
items.detail: Japan ke Kumamoto prant me subah 5.7 teevrata ka bhukamp aaya; koi sunami chetavni nahi, ek hafte tak tez jhatko ki aashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Japan: Ring of Fire par sthit, bhukamp-prone desh.

items.headline: Jeffries pehle Black Speaker ke ummidvar
items.detail: House Democrats ne band matdan me 251-11 se Hakeem Jeffries ko Speaker pad ke liye namankit kiya; 3 January ko poore House me matdan hoga, jeetne par ve pehle Black Speaker banenge.
items.exam_angle: America ke House Speaker: rashtrapati uttaradhikar me teesra sthan.
items.image_credit: Office of Representative Hakeem Jeffries, Public domain via Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: 2035 tak Islam sabse bada dharm
items.detail: Pew Research ke anuman ke mutabik 2035 tak Musalman aabadi 2.57 arab hokar Isaiyon (2.52 arab) se aage nikal jayegi; unchi janm dar is badlav ki mukhya vajah hai.
items.exam_angle: Pew Global Religious Futures: jansankhya aur dharm ka adhyayan.

items.headline: Ukraine ko EU ka 45 arab euro prastav
items.detail: European Commission ne 2027 ke liye Ukraine ko 45 arab euro ka karz prastavit kiya — 25 arab sena aur 20 arab budget ke liye; chukauti tabhi jab Russia kshatipurti de.
items.exam_angle: EU-Ukraine sahyog aur kshatipurti se judi karz shart.

items.headline: Iran ne hatya sajish ka aarop nakara
items.detail: Iran ne North Macedonia ke daave ko kharij kar diya ki usse jude network ne Greece me ek vyakti ki hatya ki sajish rachi; paanch sandigdh hirasat me hain.

items.headline: IndiGo ki Saudi udanein 30 November tak radd
items.detail: IndiGo ne Jeddah aur Madinah ki udanon ka nilamban bhi 30 November tak badha diya; ab chaaron Saudi shahron ki sabhi udanein 30 November tak radd hain.
items.exam_angle: Khadi suraksha sankat ka Bharat ki udanon par asar.

items.headline: APEC dinner me Trump-Putin mile, Xi bhi saath
items.detail: Shenzhen me APEC swagat ratribhoj me Trump aur Putin ne haath milaya, Xi paas khade the — teeno neta pehli baar ek saath dikhe; Alaska ke baad Trump-Putin ki pehli mulaqat, tri-pakshiya baithak kal.
items.exam_angle: APEC shikhar aur pehli America-China-Russia tri-pakshiya baithak.

items.headline: Israel ka Gaza me naya bhumi abhiyan
items.detail: Israel ne October 2025 yuddhaviram ke baad pehli baar madhya Gaza me Yellow Line ke paschim me bhumi karvai shuru ki; Bureij-Nuseirat ke logon ko ilaka khali karne ko kaha gaya.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram (Oct 2025) aur Board of Peace ki bhoomika.

items.headline: Uttar Korea ne Yongbyon samvardhan sanyantra badhaya
items.detail: IAEA pramukh Grossi ne kaha Uttar Korea ne Yongbyon parmanu parisar me uranium samvardhan sanyantra ka aur vistaar kar liya hai; vistaar October ke ant tak bahari roop se poora ho gaya tha.
items.exam_angle: Uttar Korea ka parmanu karyakram aur IAEA ki bhoomika — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
